messages:
Elena: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: recurring latency regressions on long multi-turns. We want incident-driven tests + a rotation plan for remediation owners. Starting thread to assign owners and timeline.

Marcus: I'll own the regression promptset curation (capture failures + near-misses, add multi-turns). Will store at infra/evals/incident-2026/curated.json. ETA 6 business days.

Priya: I'll wire CI: nightly full run + pre-merge smoke. If nightly delta >1.5% post top 5 fails; >2.5% create escalation RD-3700 draft. ETA 4 business days.

Elena: Acceptance criteria: promptset delta <= 2% abs; P95 latency regression <= +20% vs baseline for 0-1024 tokens. Owners rotate every 3 weeks if issue recurs.

Marcus: Will include golden_outputs.gz, model-hash, seed, and a short provenance.md. Will scrub PII.

Priya: Adding CI checklist to PR template: test-cmd, dataset path, golden link, reproduce steps. Also adding webhook to post failures to #eng-ml.

DevBot: Ticket created RD-3700 "Incident 2026: evals + owner rotation" linked to board "Platform: Incident Remediation".

Elena: Thanks. Recap: Marcus promptset, Priya CI, Elena tracking. Sync weekly until 3 clean full runs; rotate owner if recurring. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
